defective_pattern: Using 4-line stubs instead of extensive institutional introduction and summary sections
why_defective: Violates Directive 25 (Universal Anti-Shortcut, Zero-Fastpath, No-Rush). Academic deliverables require thorough, deep framing and concluding remarks, not minimal placeholders.
observed_symptoms: Summary sections containing only bullet points
Lack of theoretical depth or framing
corrective_remedy: Draft comprehensive introduction and summary sections adhering to doctoral-level depth and institutional standards.

detection_heuristic.trigger_rule: Word count heuristic for intro/summary sections
